senses.def: Used to warn of consequences if a specified act is done or not done: subject to the punishment of (some penalty); or (generally) subject to the circumstance of (some thing).
as written or printed
ex: this is exactly what the composer had set down on paper

senses.def: in theory; according to the assumed facts
ex: on paper the candidate seems promising

senses.def: In writing, particularly handwritten or printed as opposed to digital.
ex: During the final exam, students are allowed to bring their computer science notes that are on paper.

senses.def: Based on debatable inference; in theory; by appearances only.
ex: On paper they're perfect for each other, but it's been six months and their relationship is already on the rocks.

From those of the former generation who were in the fulness of age when I came into public life, which was while our controversy with England was on paper only, I soon saw that nothing was to be hoped.
